newsitem.title: CHINA: Lung Kee sets HK$200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee sets HK$200 mln loan.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue has been announced by arranger Fuji Bank Ltd.
BORROWER LUNG KEE METAL LTD
GUARANTOR LUNG KEE METAL HOLDINGS LTD, BERMUDA
AMOUNT HK$200 MLN DIVIDED INTO TWO TRANCHES*
(A) HK$100 MLN (B) HK$100 MLN
TYPE (A) REVOLVER (B) LOAN
MARGIN HIBOR/SIBOR+125BP MATURITY 3 YRS AVGE LIFE 2.75 YRS
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE LAUNCH 06.AUG.97
DRAWDOWN -- AVAIL 3 MTHS HOME CTRY HK/SING
REPAYMENT (B) THREE SEMI-ANNUAL INSTALMENTS AFTER 2 YRS' GRACE
GOV LAW HONG KONG REPLIES 22.AUG.97
ARRANGERS FUJI BANK (BOOKS), SANWA BANK, HK BRANCH (AGENT)
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
COMMITMENT FEE FOR TRANCHE (A) IS 25 BASIS POINTS
LEAD MANAGERS HK$25-30 MLN 40BP ALL-IN 139.54
MANAGERS HK$20-24 MLN 30BP ALL-IN 135.90
NOTES*TO BE DRAWN IN HK$ OR US$
**PROCEEDS WILL BE USED TO REFINANCE EXISTING DEBT AND FOR
GENERAL CORPORATE FUNDING
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2847 4043
